EmailTemplate.description: Is used to send automatic email when Grant Applicant lead record is denied.
EmailTemplate.name: Grant Applicant: Application Denied
EmailTemplate.subject: Application Denied
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Good evening,
On behalf of The Lactation Network, we regret to inform you that your application has not been selected for funding. This determination was made after careful consideration of your application and supporting documents.
The applicant pool was large and unfortunately, we are unable to fund all applicants at this time. Thank you for the time and effort you committed to submitting your application. We hope you continue to pursue your IBCLC journey, and we encourage you to submit another application for consideration at a later date. Our next grant cycle will begin in early summer 2025.
We wish you the best of luck, and should you need assistance or resources in the future, our team is happy to remain available.
Best,
Anna and the TLN team
